function_question: How does nature hold on tight and still let go?

opening.text: There was a girl called Mia who had a brand-new backpack for the new school term.
Mia ran across the playground with her bag bouncing on her back, packed full of books and pencils.
On the very first day of term, the zip broke! Buttons popped open when she ran, and magnets were too weak for a full bag. "There must be a better way to keep it shut!"

chapters.label: Chapter 1
chapters.title: The broken zip
chapters.line: Mia picks up her spilled books and wonders: how can a bag hold tight and still open easily?

chapters.label: Chapter 2
chapters.title: Mia asks for help
chapters.line: Mia has lots of questions, and she needs a teammate. What about you?

chapters.label: Chapter 3
chapters.title: The nature heroes
chapters.line: You and Mia head outdoors to meet plants and animals that hold on tight and still let go.

chapters.label: Chapter 4
chapters.title: The secret of tiny hooks
chapters.line: The heroes share the secret they all use.

chapters.label: Chapter 5
chapters.title: Training in the grip lab
chapters.line: Every hero needs training. Mia hands you a hook, a cup and a pile of coins.

chapters.label: Chapter 5½
chapters.title: The idea storm
chapters.line: Set the timer: it's time for a storm of ideas!

chapters.label: Chapter 6
chapters.title: The plan
chapters.line: Every great closer starts as a drawing.

chapters.label: Chapter 7
chapters.title: The big test
chapters.line: The first closer pops open. You fix it, and try again.

chapters.label: Chapter 8
chapters.title: Mia's big sprint
chapters.line: Mia sprints across the playground, and nothing falls out.

guide.brief: I'm Popi, your story guide. Mia's backpack keeps popping open, and her books go everywhere. Can you help her? Let's start!
guide.your_idea: Some engineers already have a spark of an idea. Do you?
guide.nature_clues: Nature solved this long ago. Tap each card to meet four nature heroes who hold on tight and still let go!
guide.design_secret: Here's the secret all four heroes share…
guide.skill: Scientists predict before they test. Which fabric will the hook grip best?
guide.sketch: Time to draw your closer, plus a zoomed-in view of the hooks, like a real engineer!
guide.build_and_test: Build your closer and let's see how many coins Mia's bag can hold!
guide.retry_tip: Engineers never stop at round 1. Change ONE thing and test again!
guide.ending: And ever since then, Mia's backpack stays shut with YOUR closer. She runs, jumps and skips, and not a single pencil falls out!

quick_check.question: Mia opens and closes her bag 4 times a day. How many school days until it reaches 20 uses?
quick_check.right: Right! 20 ÷ 4 = 5. That's a whole school week, so your closer must last at least that long!

clue_cards.name: Burdock burr
clue_cards.does: Snags on fur loops, rides away on an animal and drops off later.

clue_cards.name: Bird feather
clue_cards.trick: Tiny hooks called barbules hold the barbs together.
clue_cards.does: A bird re-zips a split feather by running it through its beak.

clue_cards.name: Octopus
clue_cards.trick: Every sucker seals and grips on its own.
clue_cards.does: It lets go one sucker at a time.

clue_cards.name: Pea plant
clue_cards.trick: Curly tendrils coil around a support.
clue_cards.does: The coil acts like a spring and holds on in the wind.

predict.prompt: Holds tight or comes open? Predict first!
predict.explain: Pull straight and every hook shares the load, so it holds tight. Peel it, and the hooks let go one at a time, so it opens easily.

lab.title: The grip lab
lab.predict: Which fabric will the hook grip best?

tool.name: Brainstorm
tool.intro: A brainstorm is a storm of ideas! Set a 5-minute timer and try to list 20 ways to close a bag. Today you'll learn the first 3 rules.

parts.name: Quantity
parts.what: Go for lots of ideas, fast.
parts.example: ✏️ 10 uses in 1 minute: ruler, hair stick, drumstick, bookmark…
parts.starter: Another way to close a bag could be…

parts.name: No Judging
parts.what: Every idea is allowed for now.
parts.example: ✏️ "A pencil as a tiny flagpole"? Write it down, no frowns!
parts.starter: Even if it sounds odd, I'll write down…

parts.name: Wild ideas
parts.what: Silly ideas are welcome: they spark new ones.
parts.example: ✏️ A pencil that writes on clouds!
parts.starter: My wildest bag closer would be…

sketch_checklist: I drew my closer at normal size.
I added a zoomed-in view of the hooks.
I showed what the hooks catch on.

test.check_question: Can you open it with one hand in under 3 seconds?

reflection.question: Which nature trick did your closer copy?
